deskyard remote add: save an environment as a remote

Usage: deskyard [-e NAME] remote add NAME URL --token dyt_…

Checks the token against the environment's remote access API and saves the
remote in remotes.json ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/deskyard, default ~/.config/deskyard;
mode 0600). URL is the environment's address, like https://host/alice. Tokens
come from the environment's Remote access tab. The first remote becomes the
default.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  local name for the remote, used with -e NAME (letters, digits, . _ -)
  URL        string      required  the environment's URL, e.g. https://host/alice

Options:
  --token TOKEN        access token (dyt_…); defaults to $DESKYARD_TOKEN

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard remote add alice https://deskyard.example.com/alice --token dyt_…

Where: on this machine (no remote needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
